q: Where do emissions come from at a hydrofluoric acid plant?
title: Hydrofluoric acid plant emissions
short: Hydrofluoric acid is made by reacting fluorspar with sulphuric acid in an indirectly heated rotary kiln. The kiln fuel is the main Scope 1 source. Purchased sulphuric acid and fluorspar, with its mining and drying, sit in Scope 3. HF feeds refrigerants and aluminium fluoride.

ul: Electricity for kiln drive, scrubbers and refrigeration for condensing HF.
Sulphuric acid, unless made on site.
